name: B.Sc. Hotel and Hospitality Administration
overview:
The B.Sc. in Hotel and Hospitality Administration at IHM SRM Trichy is designed to prepare students for
successful careers in the hospitality and tourism industry. The programme combines theoretical knowledge with
practical training in core areas such as Food Production, Food & Beverage Service, Front Office, and
Housekeeping. Students gain hands-on experience through modern laboratories, industry exposure, and
internships. The course focuses on communication skills, customer service, and hospitality management.
Graduates can pursue careers in hotels, resorts, airlines, cruise lines, tourism organisations, and hospitality
entrepreneurship.
duration: 3 Years (Optional 4th Year for B.Sc. Honours under NEP)
eligibility:
Passed +2 from a recognised board.
Candidates from any stream (Science, Commerce, or Arts) at the +2 level are eligible.

name: Bachelor of Physician Associates
overview: Physician Associate is an allied healthcare course that trains students in a medical model to provide preventive, diagnostic, and therapeutic care under the supervision of a physician, as part of a healthcare team.
eligibility: Candidates seeking admission must have passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) or an equivalent examination recognized by any Indian University or a duly constituted Board with a minimum of 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (individually in each subject). Candidates who have studied abroad must possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and have secured at least 50% marks each in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English up to the 12th Standard level. Candidates who have passed the Senior Secondary School Examination conducted by the National Open School with a minimum of five subjects, including either English, Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology or English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and any other language, are also eligible. Applicants must have completed 17 years of age as on 31st December of the admission year, with the maximum age limit being 40 years. At the time of application, candidates must submit a Physical Fitness Certificate issued by a registered medical practitioner and a Conduct Certificate from the educational institution last attended or any other recognized authority, as prescribed by the University regulations.

name: Bachelor of Anesthesia and Operation Theatre technology
overview: A paramedical field focused on assisting anesthesiologists and surgeons in the operation theatre. It involves preparing and maintaining surgical equipment, administering and monitoring anesthesia, ensuring patient safety during procedures, and managing sterilization and infection control in the OT environment.
eligibility: Candidates seeking admission to the Bachelor in Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology programme must have passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) or an equivalent examination recognized by any Indian University or a duly constituted Board with a minimum of 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (mandatory), with Mathematics as an optional subject. Candidates who have studied abroad must possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as mandatory subjects and Mathematics as optional up to the 12th Standard level. The qualifying examination of Foreign Nationals (FN), Persons of Indian Origin (PIO), and Children of Indian Workers in Gulf Countries (CIWGC) must be recognized as equivalent by the AIU or the Academic Council. Applicants are required to submit a Physical Fitness Certificate from a registered medical practitioner along with two character references from persons other than relatives. Admission is based on fulfillment of the eligibility criteria and successful performance in the University entrance examination and interview. The entrance test is conducted as per the CBSE 10+2 syllabus with questions distributed across Physics (25%), Chemistry (25%), Biology (25%), English (15%), and General Awareness related to healthcare (10%). Candidates shortlisted in the written examination will be called for an interview conducted by a selection board chaired by the Head of the Department of Surgery and/or Anaesthesia along with other nominated members. Final seat allotment is carried out through counselling based on merit and seat availability. Candidates who fail to attend the scheduled medical examination without approval from the competent authority under exceptional circumstances will forfeit their admission claim and waiting list status. Students who remain absent from classes for more than 15 consecutive days after admission will have their names removed from the college rolls without prior notice.

name: Master of Anesthesia and operation theatre technology
overview: An Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre (A&OT) Technologist forms an intrinsic part of any hospital. To become a trained professional one must undertake Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology (A&OTT) program. This program aims at providing advanced knowledge in the field of Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology. It aims to provide graduates who are well versed in planning, setting up, maintaining and managing the anaesthesia and surgical procedures. This program provides training on working and handling of anaesthesia and surgical equipment in and outside the Operating Room (OR). This program will bring out post graduates who are qualified and eligible to work as clinical supervisors in the Operation Theatre (OT), teach and train the students in the same specialty.
eligibility: A candidate seeking admission to Master’s in Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology program must have passed Bachelor’s degree of minimum of 3 years duration in Anaesthesia & Operation Theatre Technology/Anaesthesia Technology/ Operation Theatre Technology from a recognized university, with minimum 50% aggregate marks at HSC for open category and minimum 45% aggregate marks for reserve category.

name: Bachelor of Medical laboratory science
overview: Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science (BMLS) is an undergraduate degree program designed to prepare students for a professional career in clinical laboratory science, which plays a critical role in diagnosing, treating, and monitoring diseases.
eligibility: Candidates seeking admission to the Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science (BMLS) programme must have passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) or an equivalent examination recognized by any Indian Board, a duly constituted Board, or the National Open School with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Botany and Zoology). Admission is based on the candidate's performance in the **NEET** examination and the merit list prepared from 10+2 marks. Candidates who have studied abroad and possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and the Equivalence Committee of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP), while fulfilling the prescribed eligibility criteria, are also eligible for admission. Applicants must have completed 17 years of age on or before 31st December of the admission year and must submit a Physical Fitness Certificate issued by an authorized medical professional at the time of application to certify that they do not have any physical disability affecting their eligibility for the programme.

name: Master of Medical laboratory science
overview: The Master of Medical Laboratory Science (MMLS) is specifically aimed at those pursuing a professional career in medical laboratory science. It is designed to provide specialized training both in basic scientific principles of modern laboratory science and in the application of these principles to laboratory diagnosis and management. It is designed as a higher degree program suitable for graduates having experience in Medical Laboratory Science The program aims to enhance the scientific skills of non-medical graduates with insight into clinical problems that will allow them to work in multidisciplinary teams.
eligibility: Candidates seeking admission to the Master of Medical Laboratory Science (MMLS) programme must possess a Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science (BMLS) degree from a recognized Indian University with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks. Admission is based solely on the University entrance examination followed by a personal interview, and no direct admissions will be entertained. The entrance examination will be conducted based on the BMLS syllabus, and only candidates who qualify in the examination will be invited for the interview. The interview panel shall comprise the Dean/Principal or Head of the Department as the Chairperson, along with a Professor, Associate Professor, and other members as per the institution's policy, whose recommendations shall be final for the selection of candidates.

name: Bachelor of Emergency Medical Technologist
overview: Emergency Medical Services (EMS) represent the front line of healthcare, delivering rapid, precise, and compassionate care in life-threatening situations. The foundational philosophy of EMS emphasizes the intrinsic value of every life and the critical role timely intervention plays in patient’s outcome during the golden hour following emergencies. In India, EMS extends beyond mere service provision, acting as a critical bridge connecting emergency scenes to definitive medical care, especially in remote and under-served regions.
eligibility: Candidates seeking admission must have passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) or an equivalent examination recognized by any Indian University or a duly constituted Board with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Botany & Zoology as compulsory subjects. Admission is based on candidates who have appeared for the **NEET** examination, followed by a counselling process based on merit. Candidates who have studied abroad are eligible if they possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) or the respective University, with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English up to the 12th Standard level, securing the prescribed pass marks equivalent to 50% in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Botany & Zoology. Candidates who have passed the Senior Secondary School Examination conducted by the National Open School with a minimum of five subjects, including either English, Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology or English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and any other language, are also eligible. Applicants must have completed 17 years of age on or before 31st December of the admission year and must submit a Physical Fitness Certificate issued by a registered medical practitioner along with two character references from persons other than relatives at the time of application. Seats will be allotted through counselling based on merit and availability. Candidates who fail to attend the scheduled medical examination without approval from the competent authority under exceptional circumstances will forfeit their claim for admission and waiting list status. Students remaining absent from classes for more than 15 consecutive days after admission will have their names removed from the college rolls without prior notice.

name: Bachelor of Medical Radiology and Imaging technology
overview: Bachelor in Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology (BMRIT) program is to provide students with a high quality, well-rounded educational experience which results in graduates who possess the knowledge, skills and abilities to enter the field of diagnostic imaging as entry-level MRITs. Graduates of the BMRIT program will be able to demonstrate the necessary skills to integrate the theoretical knowledge and essential clinical skills to perform radiography, radiological and imaging procedures including interventional procedures with utmost radiation safety measures as well as to provide exemplary patient care in a variety of healthcare settings with diverse patient populations.
eligibility: Candidates seeking admission must have passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) or an equivalent examination recognized by any Indian University or a duly constituted Board with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as compulsory subjects. Candidates who have passed the Senior Secondary School Examination conducted by the National Open School with a minimum of five subjects, including either English, Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology or English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and any other language, are also eligible. Applicants must have attained 17 years of age on or before 31st December of the admission year, with the maximum age limit being 30 years. name: Master of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology
overview: The Master of Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology is a postgraduate program that provides advanced training in diagnostic imaging techniques such as X-ray, CT, MRI, and ultrasound. The course focuses on image acquisition, radiation safety, and modern imaging technologies used in disease diagnosis and treatment.
eligibility: Candidates seeking admission to the Master’s programme must possess a Bachelor in Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology (3+1), B.Sc. Medical Technology in Radio Diagnosis and Imaging, B.Sc. Radiological Technology, B.Sc. in Radiography, B.Sc. Medical Technology (X-ray), or an equivalent qualification recognized as equivalent to BMRIT, with a minimum of 60% marks in the bachelor's degree. The qualifying programme must comprise three years of academic study along with one year of compulsory internship or one year of relevant work experience. Admission is based on merit through the combined entrance examination conducted in accordance with the norms of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP)/NEET. Candidates must secure a minimum of 60% marks in the entrance examination for the General category and 55% marks for SC/ST categories to be eligible for selection. Admission notifications are published in leading English newspapers, and the final selection of candidates is made strictly as per the applicable NCAHP guidelines.
